title: Lessons Learned from Managing EPC Interfaces in Brownfield Projects (PDF)
short: An in-depth analysis of interface management challenges and lessons learned from the 70 km Amaken Gas Trunkline Project, highlighting best practices for successful EPC execution in brownfield environments.

features.rest: Based on the 70 km Amaken Gas Trunkline Project, illustrating practical EPC interface challenges and solutions.
Covers engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning interfaces in brownfield settings.
Extracts actionable insights on permits, tie-ins, change control, and multi-contractor coordination.
Integrates recognized EPC interface management tools such as interface registers, readiness reviews, and responsibility matrices.
Provides clear guidance for future brownfield projects to enhance safety, minimize rework, and deliver on schedule

title: PROJECT EXECUTION STRATEGY — ASSESS (EARLY) STAGE for Niger Delta Gas Infrastructure Expansion (NDGIE) Project (PDF)
short: The NDGIE Project Execution Strategy outlines the structured approach to deliver gas infrastructure efficiently, safely, and in alignment with regulatory and stakeholder expectations.

features.rest: Seamlessly connects gas gathering, processing, power generation, and export.
Prioritizes Nigerian participation in EPC, fabrication, and services.
Reduces risk and accelerates early gas monetization.
Robust PMC oversight across multiple EPC packages.
Early hazard identification and environmental protection measures.
Embedded community relations and regulator alignment.
Incorporates Niger Delta security realities into execution planning.
Captures flare gas, reducing CO₂ emissions by 4 million tons/year.
